chunks.arabic_text: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَلِيٍّ مَاجِيلَوَيْهِ قَالَ

translations.en: Muhammad ibn Ali Majilawayh narrated to us, he said:

chunks.arabic_text: عَنِ الْمُعَلَّى بْنِ خُنَيْسٍ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ع يَقُولُ لَيْسَ النَّاصِبُ مَنْ نَصَبَ لَنَا أَهْلَ الْبَيْتِ لِأَنَّكَ لَا تَجِدُ أَحَدًا يَقُولُ أَنَا أُبْغِضُ مُحَمَّدًا وَ آلَ مُحَمَّدٍ وَ لَكِنَّ النَّاصِبَ مَنْ نَصَبَ لَكُمْ وَ هُوَ يَعْلَمُ أَنَّكُمْ تَتَوَالَوْنَا وَ تَتَبَرَّءُونَ مِنْ أَعْدَائِنَا وَ قَالَ ع مَنْ أَشْبَعَ عَدُوًّا لَنَا فَقَدْ قَتَلَ وَلِيًّا لَنَا.

translations.en: From al-Mu'alla ibn Khunais, who said: I heard Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) saying: The Nasibi (one who is hostile to us) is not he who declares antagonism against us, the Ahl al-Bayt, because you will not find anyone who says, 'I hate Muhammad and the family of Muhammad.' But the Nasibi is he who provokes hostility against you while he knows that you support us and disavow our enemies. And he (peace be upon him) said: He who gratifies one of our enemies is killing one of our disciples (awliya).

en.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) refines the definition of the *Nasibi* by shifting the focus from overt declaration of hatred to covert hostility (*nassaba*) directed at the Shia, contingent upon their knowledge of the Ahl al-Bayt's allegiance. This distinction highlights that true enmity is measured by one's treatment of the faithful rather than mere verbal denunciation. The hadith further establishes a causal link between gratifying external enemies and the spiritual or physical demise of the Shia's supporters (*awliya*).
en.seo_question: What is the definition of a Nasibi in Shia theology according to Imam al-Sadiq?

key_terms.النَّاصِبُ: The Nasibi; one who is hostile or antagonistic, specifically to the Ahl al-Bayt.
key_terms.أَهْلَ الْبَيْتِ: The Ahl al-Bayt; the family of the Prophet.
key_terms.تَتَوَالَوْنَا: You support us (from walayah, implying love and allegiance).
key_terms.تَتَبَرَّءُونَ: You disavow (from tabarru', implying enmity to the enemies of the Ahl al-Bayt).
key_terms.وَلِيًّا: A wali; a supporter, friend, or disciple of the Ahl al-Bayt.
